question: What is the primary focus of the field of dietetics?

options.C: Manufacturing processed foods for hospital patients
options.D: Studying how food and nutrition impact human health

explanation: Dietetics centers on the scientific study of food and nutrition to guide health management and disease prevention. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h1)

question: Medical nutrition therapy is best described as what kind of intervention?

options.A: A dietary approach used to treat active medical conditions
options.B: A nursing procedure for administering total parenteral nutrition
options.C: A pharmaceutical method for synthesizing essential vitamins
options.D: A surgical technique to improve nutrient absorption in the gut

explanation: Medical nutrition therapy uses tailored nutritional interventions as a formal treatment for specific diseases. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h1)

question: Nutrition is best defined as the study of what process?

options.A: How hospitals procure therapeutic meals for ward patients
options.B: How commercial food vendors market products to the public
options.C: How agricultural policies affect national food security
options.D: How organisms take in and utilize food substances

explanation: Nutrition is a broad biological science examining how the body takes in and uses food for metabolic needs. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h2)

question: Which activity represents the distinct application of dietetics over general nutrition?

options.A: Measuring the caloric expenditure of an athlete on a treadmill
options.B: Researching the molecular structure of vitamin C in a laboratory
options.C: Designing a therapeutic low-sodium meal plan for a hypertensive patient
options.D: Analyzing the biochemical pathways of lipid metabolism in cells

explanation: Dietetics involves the practical clinical application of nutritional science to treat specific health conditions. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h2)

question: A dietitian is best described as a specialist in what area?

options.A: Managing hospital facility catering and kitchen staff
options.B: Performing routine diagnostic laboratory blood tests
options.C: Administering intravenous medications in surgical wards
options.D: Nutritional assessment and therapeutic meal planning

explanation: Dietitians specialize in evaluating nutritional needs and formulating therapeutic diets for patient care. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h3)

question: A nurse notices a patient is consistently leaving hospital meals untouched. What is the appropriate collaborative action?

options.A: Discontinue all prescribed dietary restrictions without consulting anyone
options.B: Report the poor intake to the dietitian for a dietary reassessment
options.C: Assume the patient simply dislikes hospital food and take no action
options.D: Order total parenteral nutrition immediately to replace oral intake

explanation: Nurses collaborate with dietitians by communicating patient intake issues so dietary plans can be adjusted. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h3)

question: Where does clinical dietetics practice primarily take place?
explanation: Clinical dietetics focuses on individual patient care within hospitals and clinical treatment facilities. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h4)

question: What is the primary goal of community dietetics?

options.A: Conducting biochemical research on cellular nutrient absorption
options.B: Formulating intravenous nutrition solutions for surgical intensive care
options.C: Treating acute kidney failure with specialized renal diets
options.D: Promoting public health and preventing malnutrition in populations

explanation: Community dietetics targets public health promotion and nutritional disease prevention across broader populations. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h4)

question: What is a major nutritional challenge managed in Nigerian healthcare settings?

options.A: Exclusively rare genetic metabolic disorders found in infancy
options.B: Both protein-energy malnutrition and chronic diet-related diseases
options.C: Severe vitamin toxicities caused by over-supplementation
options.D: Total absence of carbohydrate sources in local food markets

explanation: Nigerian healthcare professionals manage a double burden of undernutrition alongside rising chronic lifestyle diseases. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h5)

question: Why is it important for dietetic counseling in Nigeria to focus on locally available foods?

options.A: Hospital management prohibits the use of imported food items
options.B: Local foods contain zero carbohydrates and high pure protein
options.C: It makes dietary therapy culturally acceptable and sustainable
options.D: Imported medical foods are always toxic to African populations

explanation: Using local foods ensures patients can afford and maintain their therapeutic diets within their communities. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h5)
